title: Sugar consumption（机经听写）

paragraphs.text: The foundation. Research shows that too much sugar causes a change in mood.
Ancient humans knew sugary foods did not contain poison.
One major company has reduced the sugar fifty percent of the popular juice.
It is easier to have lower sugar in foods sold in a can than in a bottle.
The campaign to reduce salt in bread was a success.
The foundation designs a unique label for food products.
Penny Bailey believes that we can improve the food safety.
Anne-Marie Macintosh believes that sugar in cereal can stop them going soft.
Professor Prescott believes that the smell of food affects how sweet we think it tastes.
Other nutritionists recommend eating vegetables first at mealtime.
